source: CI-measured sweep 2026-07-28 (GitHub run 30387307634, ubuntu-latest / AMD EPYC 7763 / nproc=4 / 16 GB, PARALLEL=4 — the ACTUAL CI contention profile). Merged from the timings-shard-N.json artifacts of an 8-shard run, so every number is a real per-file wall under the same pool width CI uses. Covers every C member at generation time (1150/1150, no stale entries), minus the 37 docs/extensions/examples/ez-code-factory/** entries pruned with that tree in phase 9 (2026-08-03) — the remaining numbers are still the CI-measured ones, untouched; new files weigh the median (scripts/shard-plan.ts). Regenerate by merging the timings-shard-N.json artifacts from a CI run — prefer that over a local sweep, whose core count and clock do not match the runner.
